title: Structural Stress-Test Skin Pack Materialization
objective: Materialize the five UISK-12 structural stress-test Skin Packs through the completed UISR-01..06 runtime so the same shared component, screen, interaction and accessibility architecture can render radically different construction identities without behavior forks.

included: materialize Retrobit Classic Arcade, High Tech / Cyberpunk, Modern Military, Fantasy Magic and Multiversal Patchwork Reality as registry-available Skin Packs
implement pack presentation definitions for material, frame/ornament, typography/numerals, icon/motif, effects/atmosphere, shared components and specialized surfaces using existing UISR runtime seams
preserve one shared component library, screen/task architecture, focus/input model, semantic/accessibility model and responsive task transformation across all five packs
prove each pack remains structurally distinguishable beyond palette alone, including neutralized/grayscale construction evidence where applicable
implement deterministic semantically-neutral Patchwork seeded presentation assembly that cannot depend on hidden data or alter content/order/focus/layout topology
provide responsive/accessibility identity-survivor behavior, reading-assistance compatibility and safe fallbacks
focused UISR-07 tests and exact-head Linux/Windows deterministic validation
excluded: environmental/genre target pack materialization reserved for UISR-08
extreme/social/craft target pack materialization reserved for UISR-09
Tier-C release packaging, measured performance proof and destructive legacy cleanup reserved for UISR-10
application layout geometry, component/screen behavior forks, gameplay, permission, hidden-information, navigation, validation, provenance or AI authority
scope.completion_gate: All five structural stress-test packs are runtime-available through the shared Skin Pack architecture, remain recognizably distinct through allowed construction grammar beyond palette, preserve shared behavior/accessibility semantics, and Patchwork variation is deterministic and semantically neutral.

selection_boundaries: UISR-07 is selected by verified UISR-06 closeout but has no implementation authority until a later owner Continue.
Decorative geometry may alter apparent construction but may not own application layout geometry, focus order, hit targets or task topology.
No pack may require a skin-specific feature/component/screen behavior fork.
The ui-implementation lane remains parallel to product-development and may not pause or rewrite product work.
Publication to Multiversal-app main remains serialized by the OPS3 merge lease and requires fresh-base reconciliation if another lane publishes first.
next_action: Create focused UISR-07 RED tests on application base cf9a65d6cab25390340ffd761f5a2def14c881c4 for five-pack availability, beyond-palette structural differentiation, shared behavior/accessibility invariants, responsive identity survivors and deterministic semantically-neutral Patchwork assembly; then implement only the bounded presentation definitions and validate exact-head cross-platform.
